description:
During your upkeep step, activate Scroll of Fate by tapping it, manifesting Wormfang Manta from your hand.
Pay {5}{U}{U} to turn Wormfang Manta face up.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
In your draw step, Words of Wind's ability replaces your draw, instead causing you to return Wormfang Manta from the battlefield to your hand and causing each other player to return a permanent to their hand.
Wormfang Manta's LTB ability triggers, creating an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
